answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator burns authoring per alias. Because the summit hash is checked against the ocean checkpoint at intake, the dune audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. Scaling to 155 identities multiplies that fee by 434 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
